items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, I always wanted to play with Lester [Bowie] and we actually started playing together

ctx.x: So, the group is Directions, the album is titled Untitled and then the next… We have a New Directions coming up. This one is in ’78… So what happened with “Directions” and then “New Directions?”

Well, Mike left and Alex left. So, I always wanted to play with Lester [Bowie] and we actually started playing together or Lester called me to do something with him and Arthur Blythe and Claudine Amina Myers in New York. So, I really enjoyed that and I asked Lester, “Hey man, it’s an unlikely cast of characters.” Abercrombie. Eddie Gomez, who I’d worked with, done some session work with, and also then worked with Bill Evans, and we had a nice rapport together. So, I asked Eddie if he wanted to play with us and it…
When we talked about your days in Chicago, you talked about Lester and them coming up from St. Louis. Did you actually work or play with Lester back in Chicago?
